doc.title: Alan Raph interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001

title: Brookmeyer's surprising playing and nightly 'Body and Soul'
summary: Raph recalls Brookmeyer's unpredictability and how he and Wayne Andre could never guess his approach, especially on 'Body and Soul'.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: going to do in a certain tune at a certain tempo. Brookmeyer, you had an idea of the overall, but you never knew how he was going to attack it, and he always surprised you. He always surprised you. And it was a pleasant surprise. I remember listening to “Body and Soul” night after night after night and I would try and outguess him and I never did, not even once. And Wayne and I would look at each other like oh my God, isn’t this wonderful.
Yeah. Boy. Wish you could grab a little of that kind of creativity. That was what years?
